description: A `${` with no balanced `}` before `</md>` is E-MD-INTERP-UNCLOSED (even inside a code span: the splitter takes extents before the reader runs).
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 `<md>` F1 "a" (`${…}` inside `<md>` is TEXT-ONLY)
rationale: §67.2: a `${` with no balanced closing `}` before `</md>` is E-MD-INTERP-UNCLOSED; the message names `<pre>` as the way to show such text.
